name: Banyan Tree Samui
short_description: A 5-star all-pool-villa resort on a private cove overlooking Lamai Bay, with hilltop views over the Gulf of Thailand.
ai_summary: Banyan Tree Samui overlooks Lamai Bay from a private cove on Ko Samui's southeastern coast, built across cascading terraces on a hilltop. Its own Accor listing describes it as a luxury all-pool-villa resort with private beach access, blending a pristine beach setting with spa treatments and bespoke dining. No aggregate ALL guest rating was shown on the hotel's page at the time of research.

faqs.question: Where is Banyan Tree Samui located?
faqs.answer: On a private cove overlooking Lamai Bay on Ko Samui's southeastern coast, with the resort's villas set across cascading hilltop terraces facing the Gulf of Thailand. It's an all-pool-villa resort with private beach access, spa treatments, and bespoke dining, though its own Accor listing did not display an aggregate guest rating at the time of research.
